summary: Nathaniel Brassey Halhed was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Harrow School and at Christ Church in 1768. He served as an official (Beamter) with the East India Company from circa 1771 to 1785.

Nathaniel DeWitt Garson worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He earned a PhD from the University of Virginia, studying under doctoral supervisor Jeffrey Hopkins and traditional teacher Khenpo Namdrol.
Nathaniel Wallich studied at the University of Copenhagen from circa 1800 to 1806. He served as superintendent of the Acharya Jagadish Chandra Bose Indian Botanic Garden from circa 1817 to 1846.

Nathmal Tatia was an Indologist and philosopher who earned a Doctor of Literature from the University of Calcutta, studying under Satkari Mookerjee and Sukhlal Sanghvi. He served as director of the Jain Vishva Bharati Institute (attested 1982–1990).
Navina Lamminger works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at the University of Munich under the doctoral supervision of Franz-Karl Ehrhard.

Nawang Tsering Shakspo is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology who completed doctoral studies under Lal Mani Joshi. He served as a lecturer at the Central Institute of Buddhist Studies (attested 1985).
Neal Donner worked in Buddhist studies and Sinology. He completed studies at the University of British Columbia, where he was taught by Leon Hurvitz (attested 1976).

Nenghai Shi worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Peking University under Kecheng Zhang, as well as under Foyuan, Guanyi Shi, and Khangsar Rinpoche. He served as vice-president of the Buddhist Association of China (1953–1966).
Ng-Fung Yuen works in Buddhist and religious studies. She earned a PhD from the University of the West under the supervision of Kottegoda Warnasuriya (attested 2009).
Ngak Sé Rigpé Dorjé studied under Khenpo Jigme Phuntsok and Khenpo Tsultrim Lodro.
Ngakchang Gönpo Tsé Ten studied under Dilgo Khyentse and Dudjom Rinpoche.
Ngan-che Chan is a scholar of Buddhist studies who earned a PhD at The University of Hong Kong under the supervision of Jing Yin (attested 2007) and also studied under K. L. Dhammajoti.
Ngawang Jorden works in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He held a post at Sakya College and served as director of the International Buddhist Academy.
Ngawang Lek Shé Gyatso studied under Dilgo Khyentse, Dodrupchen Rinpoche, and Trulshik Rinpoche.

Ngawang Wangyal worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He earned a geshe degree at Drepung Monastery under Agvan Dorzhiev, founded the Tibetan Buddhist Learning Center, and taught at Columbia University from circa 1962 to 1974.

Ngorpa Pönlob Lo Ter Wangpo studied under Jamgön Kongtrul Lodrö Thaye, Shechen Gyaltsab, Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso, and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, and taught Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö and Khenpo Shenga.

Ngulchu Dharmabhadra was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied at Tashi Gephel Monastery and under Yeshe Päldrup, Lobzang Tsultrim, Ngulchu Ngawang Dorje, and Lobpön Lozang Gyaltsen.
Nguyen Thi Tuyet works in Buddhist studies. She earned a PhD at Punjabi University under supervisor Inder Mohan Singh and studied under traditional teacher Thich Nu Bao Nguyet (attested 2012).
Nguyen Thi Xinh works in Buddhist studies and philosophy. She completed a PhD at Punjabi University under the supervision of Gurjit Singh Mann (attested 2013).
Nguyen Van Hoa is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Indology who completed a PhD at Savitribai Phule Pune University under the doctoral supervision of Shailaja Bapat and Lata Chhatre (attested 2009).
